title: Meet the Warden at the Ashward almshouse
notes: Note says: tomorrow's dusk bell, come alone, tell no one in a red collar.

updates.note: Done: met Warden Kaselle; captured Peret, Vesan and Wyn; Peret in the Collarhouse, brothers and Kaselle at Okton's forge.

title: Hold Halda's rope line at the Great Pyre
notes: Dusk bell; double pay; stand where she puts you.

title: Get Isine out through the Saltgate at the dusk rotation
notes: Pass in hand; Wilash is the escort; cart at the triage tent.

title: Prove the Coal did not choose Kitwin before noon
notes: She holds the oath 'until the Coal chooses'. Without proof by noon she opens the gates and the Watch accepts Coldwell.
